audience_differences.summary: About 19 of 19 visitors understood Infobric as a Swedish digital-services and technology company for construction and site-based operations, and valued that the homepage matched their assignment topic through wording such as "Vi digitaliserar byggbranschen" [persona][site]. They were not ready to contact the company because they were students or researchers rather than buyers, while specialist terms such as "Personalliggare" and "Föranmälan" and limited company background held them back; although they valued the information, about 19 of 19 visitors needed more company history, size and background facts first [persona][site].

About 50 of 50 visitors understood the offer as a connected construction and site-business ecosystem covering people, vehicles, machines and tools, and valued the relevance of "Fordonshantering" and "Maskin- & verktygshantering" plus the credibility signal "Betrodd av över 12 000 kunder och 450 000 användare" [persona][site]. Price was absent for about 50 of 50 visitors, while about 43 of 50 valued the offer but were not ready to contact sales because they first needed comparable customer references, clearer product fit, implementation, integration and hardware details, and commercial information [persona].

About 129 of 142 visitors understood Infobric as a connected system for personnel, vehicles, machines, tools and site operations, and valued familiar areas such as "Fordonshantering" and "Maskin- & verktygshantering" for driving-log, cost, mileage and equipment-control problems [persona][site]. Price was a barrier for about 142 of 142 visitors, and construction-focused language such as "Vi digitaliserar byggbranschen" and "Föranmälan" weakened perceived relevance; although about 138 of 142 valued the offer, they needed comparable references, specific functionality, pricing, integrations with finance or ERP systems, data-handling information and setup details before contacting [persona][site].

About 119 of 119 visitors understood the offer as one platform connecting personnel, vehicles, machines and tools, and valued practical help with unreliable driving logs, locating equipment and controlling fleet use through areas such as "Fordonshantering" and "Maskin- & verktygshantering" [persona][site]. About 114 of 119 valued the offer but were not ready to contact because price, relevant customer proof, hardware, setup, tracking mechanics and everyday operation were unclear; wording such as "Föranmälan" and "Vi digitaliserar byggbranschen" also made some non-construction contexts feel less clearly included [persona][site].

About 70 of 79 visitors understood Infobric as a broad connected ecosystem for vehicles, machines, tools and field operations, and valued the promise in "Vi kopplar ihop det digitala ekosystemet" alongside solutions for fleet and equipment visibility [persona][site]. About 72 of 79 valued the offer but were not ready to contact because they first needed clear product fit, rental workflows, implementation, hardware, comparable customer references and pricing; the construction framing "Vi digitaliserar byggbranschen" made relevance for rental, transport and service operations uncertain for about 48 of 79 visitors [persona][site].

About 70 of 70 visitors understood the offer as a construction-focused system bringing personnel, machines, tools and vehicles together, and valued the ability to see equipment location, ownership, usage and status through "personal, maskiner och fordon i ett och samma ekosystem" [persona][site]. About 65 of 70 valued the offer but were not ready to contact because they needed comparable references, specific product detail, pricing, hardware, setup and implementation information; the construction positioning and terms such as "Föranmälan" could also make fit less clear for adjacent business types [persona][site].

About 15 of 32 visitors understood Infobric as a broad digital ecosystem for construction and site businesses, while about 8 of 32 specifically recognised HSE, KMA, personnel-register and site-compliance solutions; they valued the industry credibility of "Betrodd av över 12 000 kunder och 450 000 användare" [persona][site]. About 29 of 32 valued the offer but were not ready to contact because they needed specific product explanations, comparable references, pricing and implementation information, and about 25 of 32 found the broad "Vi kopplar ihop det digitala ekosystemet" framing unclear as a starting point for their particular HSE or compliance need [persona][site].

journey.information_order: [site] The homepage first presents broad construction positioning, including “Vi digitaliserar byggbranschen” and “Vi kopplar ihop det digitala ekosystemet”, followed by solution cards such as “Fordonshantering” and “Maskin- & verktygshantering”, trust proof, audience routes and contact options. [persona] About 343 of 499 prospect visitors would learn more rather than contact immediately, indicating that visitors generally need solution-specific detail after the broad opening. [analytics] The homepage has 1.17 views per session and 43.76% quick backs, suggesting that the initial order may not consistently match visitor expectations.
journey.answers_when_questions_arise: [persona] About 492 of 499 prospect visitors need pricing or a cost indication, about 430 of 499 need relevant references, about 334 of 499 need setup-time information, about 271 of 499 need integration information, about 177 of 499 need data-privacy information and about 159 of 499 need hardware information. [site] The page establishes relevance with “Fordonshantering”, “Maskin- & verktygshantering” and “Körjournal, CO2, kostnadskoll och mycket mer – samlat på ett ställe.”, but it does not answer the commercial and implementation questions early enough. [persona] Visitors would be better served if each solution section answered fit, outcome, price range, setup, integrations and data handling before the contact prompt.
journey.how_it_works_in_practice: [persona] About 334 of 499 prospect visitors want setup-time information and about 159 of 499 want hardware information, so product labels and benefit statements do not sufficiently explain practical operation. [site] “Se när, var och hur era maskiner och verktyg används” communicates the intended outcome, while “Vi kopplar ihop det digitala ekosystemet” remains abstract about devices, tags, data capture, integrations and rollout. [persona] Visitors need a concrete workflow showing what is installed or connected, how data is collected, how users work with it daily and how existing finance, payroll or ERP systems are affected.
journey.interested_but_not_ready: [persona] About 478 of 499 prospect visitors need references before proceeding, while about 48 of 499 would contact sales, 343 of 499 would learn more and 27 of 499 would come back later. [persona] The main readiness barrier is not recognition of the problem but insufficient proof, pricing and implementation detail. [site] “Betrodd av över 12 000 kunder och 450 000 användare” is a strong credibility signal, but visitors still want named comparable customers, measurable outcomes and sector-specific cases. [persona] A lower-commitment route such as an email guide, indicative price or clearly described demo could help interested visitors continue without requiring an immediate sales conversation.
journey.layout_navigation_forms: [site] Clearly named solution cards, audience segmentation and the “Kontakt” or “Kontakta oss” routes provide understandable entry points; “Fordonshantering” was familiar to about 401 of 499 prospect visitors and “Maskin- & verktygshantering” to about 338 of 499. [site] The contact destination offers phone support, “Chatt & Supportartiklar”, “Lämna ett meddelande” and office locations. [persona] About 141 of 142 finance or administration visitors found contact information, but about 121 of 142 had to take an additional step before seeing or reaching a message form. [persona] About 46 of 499 prospects expected a direct demo or meeting route, yet the page mainly provides general contact channels rather than a dedicated booking flow.
journey.unnecessary_effort_or_uncertainty: [persona] About 492 of 499 prospect visitors face uncertainty because no price or cost indication is available, and about 430 of 499 need stronger customer proof. [persona] About 334 of 499 need setup-time information and about 271 of 499 need integration information before they can judge feasibility. [site] Construction-specific terms such as “Föranmälan”, “Personalliggare” and “KMA” are presented as solution names without enough plain-language explanation; “Föranmälan” felt written for someone else to about 141 of 499 visitors. [persona] Fleet, rental, transport, finance and HSE visitors may therefore spend effort interpreting the offer, checking whether it applies to them and searching for commercial or technical information before deciding whether to contact the company.
